headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated net revenue across Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated Net Revenue ($M): Wall Street consensus models $122,500M in Q3 2026E (+19.7% YoY vs $102,346M in Q3 2025); buy-side whisper targets $125,000M fueled by acceleration in Google Cloud AI workloads and YouTube subscriptions.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Wall Street consensus Diluted EPS for Q3 2026E ($2.97) vs Buy-Side Whisper ($3.12).
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Diluted EPS ($): Sell-side consensus expects $2.97 per share; buy-side whisper bogeys target $3.12+ driven by operating leverage across Google Services and expanding Cloud operating margins.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total revenue generated by Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Workspace enterprise accounts.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Google Cloud Revenue ($M): Printed $13,650M in Q2 2026 (+32% YoY); Street consensus models $14,800M for Q3 2026E with whisper looking for $15,200M+ on surging generative AI infrastructure demand and TPU v5e/v5p/Trillium deployments.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Core advertising revenue generated on Google Search, Maps, and AI Overviews query surfaces.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Google Search Revenue ($M): Core search engine printed $61,200M in Q2 2026; Street consensus models $63,500M in Q3 2026E (whisper $64,500M) as AI Overviews ads successfully monetize commercial queries.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total revenue generated across YouTube ad placements, YouTube Music, and YouTube Premium subscriptions.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: YouTube Total Revenue ($M): Combined advertising and subscription run-rate printed $11,500M in Q2 2026; Street models $12,200M in Q3 2026E with whisper at $12,600M fueled by Shorts monetization and connected TV market share.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Capital expenditures deployed toward AI servers, custom TPUs, networking, and data center buildouts.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: AI Infrastructure CapEx ($M): Exploded to $44,924M in Q2 2026 as Alphabet aggressively scaled data centers; Street expects Q3 CapEx around $42,000M–$45,000M to support Gemini 2.5/3.0 foundation model training and cloud customer inference.
